title: Ultherapy vs Radiofrequency Tightening
h1: Ultherapy vs radiofrequency: two ways to tighten skin
desc: Ultherapy vs radiofrequency (Morpheus8, Forma, Iced RF, Venus Legacy): depth, results, sessions, downtime and who each suits, at Skin & Laser Dubai Marina.
answer: Ultherapy uses imaging-guided focused ultrasound to lift the deepest supporting layer in usually one session. Radiofrequency treatments such as Morpheus8, Forma, Iced RF and Venus Legacy heat the dermis to tighten and firm, usually over several sessions, and Morpheus8 also improves texture and scars. They can be combined.
body:
## Which concern each addresses

- Jowls, brow and neck lift: Ultherapy or HIFU
- Firmness and glow without downtime: Forma, Iced RF, Venus Legacy
- Laxity with scars or rough texture: Morpheus8

## Limits

Neither replaces a surgical facelift for very loose skin. See [skin tightening](/skin-tightening-dubai/) for the full picture.
faq: Can Ultherapy and RF be combined?
Yes, for example Ultherapy once a year with RF maintenance.
Ultherapy results often last a year or more; RF is maintained with periodic sessions.
